نتقادم (form VI)
# نَتَقَادَمُ (nataqādamu) /na.ta.qaː.da.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
# نَتَقَادَمَ (nataqādama) /na.ta.qaː.da.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
# نَتَقَادَمْ (nataqādam) /na.ta.qaː.dam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَادَمَ (taqādama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
